prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Never Lose a Great Idea Again
plan.description: A quick launch video for a note-taking app that captures ideas fast and keeps them easy to find. See how simple notes can be.

beats.narration: You had a brilliant idea this morning. Where is it now? Lost in a messy pile of notes again.
Meet the note-taking app that keeps up with you. Open it, type or speak, and your thought is saved.
Search helps you find your notes. Your notes stay organized and always ready when inspiration strikes.
Download the app today. Write it down, and keep every great idea.

warnings: length: the narration totals 70 words in 4 beats but a 30-second video needs about 58 (between 52 and 58). Cut about 12 words: 3 to 4 beats of about 19 words each (you averaged 17; count the words of every beat), one idea, no preamble and no recap; keep the hook and the last line
grounding: 2 beats had unsupported specifics, 2 rewritten
